findings.problem: "6 to 10 oz" of brewed coffee was the author's own estimate and no source gave it. A refuter search found Homegrounds (8 oz with one shot) and A Couple Cooks (10 oz).
findings.change: Now "8 to 10 oz" in all three places, with both pages added to sources. It still fits the warmed 12 oz mug, inside the Batch Brew card's 6 to 12 oz.
